THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON1956 REVISED EDITION
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour whichaccompanies this order exists between –
Mr. J.K. de Silva, No. 8-5/4, Golf Wing, Trilliam Residencies, No. 153, Elvitigala Mawatha, Colombo 08 of the one part.
and
Ethihad Airways, 3rd Floor, East Tower, World Trade Centre, Colombo 01.of the other part

NOW THEREFORE I, W.D.J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development do by virtue of thepowers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions)Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint
Mr. S. Kariyawasam, No. 75, Melpitiya, Matale.
to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations andSabaragamuwa Development.
Colombo.28th December, 2017.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON1956 REVISED EDITION
Mr. J.K. de Silva, No. 8-5/4, Golf Wing, Trilliam Residencies, No. 153, Elvitigala Mawatha, Colombo 08 of the one part.
and
Ethihad Airways, 3rd Floor, East Tower , World Trade Centre, Colombo 01 of the other part..
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

“Whether Mr. J.K. De Silva had been caused injustice by the payment of the Salary without allowances, not letting him report to work from08.11.2016 to 03.07.2017 and termination of employement from 03.07.2017 and if so, what reliefs he is entitled.’’
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 19th day of December, 2017.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON1956 REVISED EDITION
Order under Section 4(2)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour whichaccompanies this order exists between –
All Ceylon Telecommunication Employees’ Union, 3rd Floor ‘A’ Building , Lotus Road, Colombo 01of the one part.( on behalf of 2168 employees)
AND
Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, Lotus Road,Colombo 01of the other part.

NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Developmentdo by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(2) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon(1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 62 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby refer aforesaid dispute for settlement to an Industrial Court which shall be constituted in accordancewith the provisions of Section 22 of the said Act.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations andSabaragamuwa Development.
Colombo.28th December, 2017.
My No.: IR/COM/3/A/2016/38.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON 1956 REVISED EDITION
All Ceylon Telecommunication Employees’ Union, 3rd Floor‘A’ Building, Lotus Road, Colombo 01 of the one part( on behalf of 2168 employees)
AND
Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, Lotus Road,Colombo 01.of the other part
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE

“Whether the 2168 employees stated in Schedule 01, employed in the main business of Sri Lanka Telecom PLC have been caused injusticeby not being given a formal appointment letter and the privileges and releifs given to other employees of Sri Lanka Telecom PLC and if so,to what reliefs they are entitled.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 25th day of November, 2017.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
